description: The key light's shadow flags of every venue mesh at the tiers that cast one, read off the objects the web's production renderer (`CourseRenderer3D`, built headless as its own tests build it) puts in its scene, under the names the vendored GLBs use (#96). `cast` / `receive` are three.js castShadow / receiveShadow; `parent` is the mesh's ancestry below the venue root.
